Name: Ruffwear BackTrak Evacuation Kit Dog Harness, Cloudburst Gray, Large
Description: **Remember to measure your pet for the perfect fit.** Be prepared for emergencies with the Ruffwear BackTrak Evacuation Kit Dog Harness. This kit includes a lightweight first-aid muzzle and a human vest with a built-in dog-carrying sling, making it perfect for unexpected situations where your furry friend may need assistance. The first-aid muzzle is adjustable and easy to secure behind your BFF’s ears, while the human vest features adjustable waist, chest, and lightly padded shoulder straps for a comfortable fit. The continuous-support webbing straps help distribute weight, and the color-coded adjustable straps on the dog sling make it easy to attach your dog in either the front or back. Please practice using the kit before your next adventure to ensure success in case of an emergency. Sizing is based on your dog’s girth size, while the human vest measurements are the same for all sizes: The chest strap fits up to 67" (170 cm), and the waist strap fits up to 79" (200 cm).
